post.summary: Sign in as a guest with a display name

201.description: The new user. The session cookie is set

204.description: Signed out. The session cookie is cleared

get.description: The `waiting` games, newest first, at most 50. Full games stay in the list: the client shows them as full.

post.description: The caller owns the game and gets the first seat, named after their display name.

get.description: The `waiting` and `active` games where the user has a seat or controls a hot-seat seat, newest first. Finished games are not listed.
Any signed-in user can read it. The game id is the invite.

200.description: The game with its seats in order

delete.description: Owner only, only while the game is `waiting`. Deletes the game; seats and invites go by cascade. The clients learn it from `room.cancelled`.

post.description: Adds a seat named after the user. `seat_name_taken` means a hot-seat seat has this name: its controller removes it and adds it again with another name.

200.description: The game with the new seat

post.description: Removes every seat the caller controls, hot-seat seats included. The owner cannot leave.

200.description: The game without the seats of the caller

post.description: The seat is controlled by the caller, who must have a seat in the game.

201.description: The game with the new hot-seat seat

put.summary: Change the token of a seat
put.description: Only the controller of the seat, only while the game is `waiting`. `token_taken` means another seat has the token.

200.description: The game with the new token

post.description: Owner only, while the game is `waiting`. The name must match a user exactly, ignoring case. An invite does not hold a seat. A declined or expired invite goes back to `pending`.

201.description: The game with the new invite in `invites`

post.description: Owner only, with at least two seats. Writes the version 0 snapshot and sets the status to `active`.

200.description: The active game and its redacted start state

get.description: The pending invites of the user, newest first.

post.description: Only the invitee. A normal join with the same errors, and the invite becomes `accepted` in the same transaction.

200.description: The game with the new seat

post.description: Only the invitee. The host can invite the same user again.

post.summary: Submit an action for a seat
post.description: The server sets `playerId` from `seatId`. A repeat of the same `clientActionId` returns the stored `version` and `events` with the current `state`.

get.description: For `active` and `finished` games. A game that is still `waiting` has no state.

get.summary: Read the result of a finished game
get.description: For `finished` games. `standings` are in rank order: rank 1 is the winner, the others rank by elimination order (the last one out is 2). A round is `1 + floor(TurnEnded events so far / seats at game start)`; `rounds` is the round at the end and `outRound` the round in which a player went out. Net worth is cash, plus the price of each owned property (half when mortgaged), plus the build cost of each house and hotel. A player who is out has cash, properties and net worth 0. Answers 409 `game_not_finished` while the game is `waiting` or `active`, and for a finished game that has no winner.

get.summary: Open the event stream of games, the lobby and the invites of the user
get.description: Server-sent events. Topics: `game:<id>` (seated users only), `lobby` (any signed-in user) and `user:<id>` (only that user, else 403 `forbidden_topic`). Each message has `event:` set to its type (`snapshot`, `room.updated`, `room.cancelled`, `game.actions`, `lobby.snapshot`, `lobby.updated`, `lobby.removed`, `invites.updated`) and `data:` set to the JSON envelope `{ topic, type, version, payload }`. `id:` is the engine version and is set only on `snapshot` of a started game and on `game.actions`; the lobby and user messages have no id. A comment line every 15 seconds keeps the stream open. After a reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` and exactly one game topic, the missed `game.actions` are replayed when the gap is 1 to 100 versions, and a `snapshot` is sent when the gap is larger, the id is not a valid version, or the game is not `active`. Each connect to `lobby` or `user:<id>` gets the full list.

200.description: An event stream, kept open until the client disconnects
